value.name: cuddle on sofa
value.description: Miles and Marylin sit closely together on a small sofa while watching a cable movie.
evidence: Miles and Marylin watching a cable movie crowded together on the small sofa.

value.name: Miles rejects distance
value.description: Marylin offers to move, but Miles insists she stay close to him.
evidence: MARYLIN I'm sorry. I'm squishing you. I'll move to the...
MILES No. Stay. I want you close to me.

value.name: Miles critiques couch as unwed
value.description: Miles says the couch does not feel like a married couch, revealing his concern with making the home feel marital.
evidence: This couch is wrong. It's not a "married couch."

value.name: Miles labels house bachelor pad
value.description: Miles surveys the room and declares the house a bachelor pad rather than a married home.
evidence: He surveys his surroundings with a critical eye.
In fact, this is not a married house -- it's a bachelor pad.

value.name: Miles admits room conversions
value.description: Miles explains that he has turned most of the house's bedrooms into stereotypically masculine hobby rooms.
evidence: I know. But I've converted most of them into ridiculous "Guy" rooms -- a billiard room, a card room, a gym --

value.name: Miles asks Marylin to personalize house
value.description: Miles urges Marylin to go out and buy feminine, personal items so she can make the house feel like hers.
evidence: Honey, want you to go out, as soon as you feel up to it -- and buy married things. Woman things. Personalize it. Marylinize it. Make this your house.

value.name: Miles gives Marylin credit card
value.description: Miles hands Marylin his credit card and tells her to spend freely, signaling trust and commitment.
evidence: He hands her a credit card.
Here's my card. Spend as much as you want. We get mileage.

value.name: Marylin jokes about decorating
value.description: Marylin responds playfully that she could make the house more feminine with decorative touches.
evidence: Well, I suppose I could "girly" it up for you with a little Fortuny, and some passementerie --

value.name: Miles misunderstands decor terms
value.description: Miles asks whether Marylin's decorative terms are foods, showing his cluelessness and comic mismatch with her sophistication.
